name: Wyckoff Sunday Weekly Analysis
prompt:
Run the Wyckoff weekly entry funnel (prescreen → Wyckoff LLM → news-validate top cut → up to 5 tiered STRONG/BORDERLINE picks):

```bash
cd ~/.hermes/skills/wyckoff && .venv/bin/python scripts/weekly.py >> logs/weekly.log 2>&1
```

If the command exits with a non-zero status, report the last 30 lines of logs/weekly.log to Roy. Otherwise respond with [SILENT].
